origin.description: Extract every literal match from each string.
origin.usage: stri_extract_all_fixed(str, pattern, simplify = FALSE, omit_no_match = FALSE, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: FALSE returns a list. TRUE pads a character matrix with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If TRUE, a string with no match contributes an empty vector instead of NA.

origin.details: With simplify FALSE, each element is the matches for one pair. No match is a single NA unless omit_no_match is TRUE. simplify TRUE or NA calls stri_list2matrix by row, padding with an empty string or NA, and the minimum width is 0. An empty pattern is a one-element NA vector. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: A list of character vectors, or a character matrix when simplify is not FALSE.
origin.example:
found <- stri_extract_all_fixed("abaBAba", "Aba", case_insensitive = TRUE, overlap = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_extract_all_fixed("abaBAba", "Aba", case_insensitive=TRUE, overlap=TRUE) returns ', paste(found[[1]], collapse = ", "), '.\n'))

translation.description: Extract every literal match from each string.
translation.usage: stri_extract_all_fixed(str, pattern, simplify=False, omit_no_match=False, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: False returns a list of lists. True pads a matrix with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If true, a string with no match contributes an empty list instead of NA.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is honored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: If true, matches may share code points.

translation.details: With simplify false, each element is the matches for one pair. No match is a single NA unless omit_no_match is true. simplify true or NA builds a matrix by row, padding with an empty string or NA. An empty pattern is a one-element NA list. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of lists of strings and NA, or a list of padded rows when simplify is not false.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_extract_all_fixed
found = stri_extract_all_fixed("abaBAba", "Aba", case_insensitive=True, overlap=True)
print('stri_extract_all_fixed("abaBAba", "Aba", case_insensitive=True, overlap=True) returns ' + ", ".join(found[0]) + ".")
